GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (8 Mar 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1564)
APO 500
8 March 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 5 February 1947, file AG 000.5 (5 Feb 47)LS-R, (SCAPIN 1506) wherein the Imperial Japanese Government was directed to deliver one ITEZONO, Tatsuo, Maj., to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp) at the earliest possible date, is amended to delete said ITEZONO's name for the reason he is the same man who appeared on L.S. Appre. Memo. dated 10 January 1947, and is presently interned at Sugamo Prison. This name appears as the fourth name on Page No. 2 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ John B. Cooley
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
